paragraphs: Rabbi Berekhiah bar Chama the priest. In Rabbah, end of section Tissa: “Rabbi Berekhiah the priest Berabbi, in the name of Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani: the tablets were six in length …” But the words “bar Nachmani” are not there. In chapter 28: “Rabbi Berekhiah said, ‘The tablets …’”; “priest” is not there. In the name of Rabbi Shmuel.
